purpose: Resolve whether specific censored cases are corporate actions, suspensions or unknown fills before defining another model study. Do not retroactively revise previous trial outcomes.
raw_report_scope: Full official reports may include other securities; preserve as evidence only. Normalized event output admits exact mother-date electronics membership only. No full-market model fallback.
network_budget: Thirteen planned requests, each at most two attempts; sequential >=1.5sec spacing, <=25sec timeout. Retain errors and response bytes, no access-control bypass. Additional exploratory source-discovery probes are separately retained, not claimed as planned collection.
mandatory_rules: Validate response status, echoed range/title, schema, unique event identities, finite positive prices and source/effective dates; never equate HTTP200 with data success
Quarantine latest financial-statement/NAV/EPS columns from historical data projections even when the source appends them to historic events
Record fetched_at_utc separately from original publication timestamp; original first-seen and revision history remain UNKNOWN unless actually evidenced
Reference-price ratios are not assumed to be total-return or share-adjustment factors
Cash payouts, share entitlements, paid subscription rights, delivery dates and identity changes require their own verified terms; missing terms block adjusted PnL
Suspension explains missing OHLC but does not create a fill or permit carrying a guessed price
Daily OHLC/volume or opening reference prices cannot prove auction fills or queue position
Do not overwrite raw mother, old plans, old trial results or ledgers
No new model study until required data readiness is explicitly assessed; this data-only stage launches zero trials
